phase: CPI-E1-P10E Phase 0 - after-cost strategy/economics methodology freeze

p10d_authority.interpretation: PROMISING HISTORICAL DIAGNOSTIC; durable predictive edge, after-cost economics, prospective validation, and trading authority remain unestablished

exploratory_disclosure: This strategy rule is POST-P10D / EXPLORATORY because P10D already exposed the Reuters directional diagnostic on this four-event cohort. The future P10E historical economics result must not be described as preregistered before predictor testing, independent validation, out-of-sample validation, or durable proof.

strategy_hypothesis.name: REUTERS-vs-MARKET DISAGREEMENT CROSS
strategy_hypothesis.universe: P10D primary-eligible siblings at their already-frozen P10D cutoffs
strategy_hypothesis.reuters_direction: YES iff Reuters value > the strict contract threshold; otherwise NO; Reuters point forecasts are never converted to probabilities
strategy_hypothesis.market_direction: YES iff yes_ask > 0.5; NO iff yes_ask < 0.5; exact 0.5 is TIE
strategy_hypothesis.trade_rule: Trade only when Reuters direction differs from market direction; buy exactly one contract on the Reuters-indicated side
strategy_hypothesis.sizing: ONE contract per qualifying disagreement sibling; no Kelly sizing, leverage, compounding, or outcome-dependent sizing

execution_price_authority.yes_execution: required canonical YES-side crossing price = positively established yes_ask at the frozen cutoff
execution_price_authority.no_execution: required canonical NO-side crossing price = positively established no_ask, which P9A derives as 1 - yes_bid and labels DERIVED_COMPLEMENT
execution_price_authority.unavailable_rule: If the required side-specific crossing price cannot be positively established, mark the signal TRADE SIGNAL BUT EXECUTION EVIDENCE UNAVAILABLE; do not invent a price or score it as zero P&L
execution_price_authority.authority_boundary: P9A proves retrospective displayed quote evidence only; it does not prove contemporaneous execution, fill, queue position, or capacity

quote_depth_slippage_authority.historical_depth: NOT PROVEN by the canonical P9A artifacts
quote_depth_slippage_authority.primary_slippage_rule: zero additional arbitrary slippage; use only the canonical crossing price
quote_depth_slippage_authority.capacity_classification: DISPLAYED-QUOTE AFTER-FEE HISTORICAL ECONOMICS, not fully executable capacity-proven economics
quote_depth_slippage_authority.depth_consumption: not applicable unless a future reviewed artifact positively establishes depth; no depth rule is invented in Phase 0

fee_authority.formula_authority: P9B records the 0.07 * C * P * (1-P) next-cent formula for a directly evidenced 2022 schedule, but does not establish that formula continuously or exactly for the P10D executions
fee_authority.coverage_status: zero exact historical P10D execution rows; interval-unproven, locator-only, and unknown rows are not consumable
fee_authority.rounding_side_price_count_authority: not consumable for the required historical executions
fee_authority.hard_gate: If exact historical fee authority is unavailable for any required execution, no after-cost result may be calculated

settlement_authority.source: P7/P10A reviewed CPI settlement reconciliation and P9A/P10D binding
settlement_authority.binding: Settlement outcome must come only from the already-reviewed CPI truth / P10A binding authority; no independent inference is permitted
settlement_authority.one_contract_win: canonical contract payout ($1.0000 under the reviewed binary settlement evidence)
settlement_authority.settlement_binding: finalized reviewed result and settlement value only

denominator_and_inclusion.missing_execution: signal_count includes every disagreement signal; executable_count includes only positively price-authorized signals; unavailable_execution_count is reported separately; unavailable rows are not silently zeroed or selectively removed
denominator_and_inclusion.common_denominator_failure: If missing execution evidence prevents a legitimate common historical economic denominator, fail closed

aggregation_and_metrics.primary_aggregation: Compute each qualifying sibling's one-contract net economic result; arithmetic mean executed qualifying results within each event; event result is 0 when the event has no disagreement signals; equal-weight the four event-level results

interpretation_boundary.negative_result_use: may reject or weaken this strategy hypothesis

phase1_sealed_run_plan.execution: designed but not executed in Phase 0
steps: exactly one real historical economics run
no scorer modification after result exposure
phase1_sealed_run_plan.digest_rule: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and deterministic separators, computed over the artifact with its digest field omitted; result digest uses the same rule
